prompt: Critical Reminders are injected at session-start. Doesn't that mean turn-1 is when the agent learns the rules?

transcript_anchor.description: Session 44 deliberation — the assumption 'Critical Reminders only need to fire at turn 1' was falsified when extended sessions drifted from the rules. Critical Reminders crystallized as a mid-session refresh mechanism, not a turn-1-only injection.

condition_shift.past_state: Assumption: turn-1 injection of Critical Reminders is sufficient
condition_shift.current_state: Session 44 falsified — long sessions need recurring refresh; turn-1 alone is not enough
condition_shift.delta: Assumption falsified directly by observed drift mid-session; the engineering response was to add mid-session refresh

pass_criterion: Agent must reference Session 44's falsification of the turn-1-only assumption, name the recurring-refresh response, and recommend NOT designing future memory-injection mechanisms on the falsified turn-1-only assumption.
